notes: New browser engine (Chrome 151) installs once by itself: emoji and Bengali / Hindi / Arabic and other scripts show correctly in Mobile mode. Useragent: the sheet, the browser and its headers now always say the same Chrome build. GPM: an account first used in EMU2 keeps its useragent and its device (same GPU, CPU, RAM) when it moves to GPM; GPM Mac/Linux profiles get a real Chrome useragent; GPM Mac/Linux devices now work in EMU2 too (Apple voices, Mac/Linux fonts). Page - Follow profile/page: follows go from the page (never the main account), one page switch for many UIDs, much faster, closed window stops cleanly. Browser Stop now stops every browser task at once (also windows still opening or parked); launch gap follows the setting. More Facebook screens recognised (new password, 2FA, consent, restriction notice, Remember Password); Russian / Chinese words added. Mobile mode: page width exact at 125% display.
